writtenBy: rollout C0 foundation (2026-11-24), read from scripts/scripts.js + scripts/aem.js

foundation.boxSizing: per-container as the canon (stardust/prototypes/canon.css): NO global border-box reset; a block sets box-sizing explicitly wherever its prototype CSS does
foundation.breakpoints: mobile-first; the source switches are (width > 768px) and (width > 1024px); no target list set
foundation.fonts: styles/fonts.css: montserrat 200/300/400/500/700/800, "icomoon-the7-font" (var(--ca-icon-font)), "Font Awesome 5 Free" 900 (var(--ca-fa-font)); montserrat-fallback in styles.css
foundation.sectionShell: main > .section = the canon .wf-wrap (max 1250, side pad 60/30); the first section and the section after a full-bleed one get padding-top 60px; main padding-bottom 60px (= #main 60px 0). Full-bleed escape: .hero-slider-container or section style `full-bleed` (max-width none, padding 0)
foundation.fadeIn: import { fadeInOnView } from '../../scripts/canon-motion.js' — the WPBakery fadeIn (.wpb-animate / .wpb-start-animation, 1s)
foundation.chromeIds: the header block owns #phantom, #mobile-drawer, #site-title, #site-description, .scroll-top and sets main#main (skip link); the footer owns #the7-search

pageMetadata.header-veil: masthead veil: `amber` = rgb(221 153 51 / 50%) (the-garden, culture, events, reservations-2, privacy-policy-and-cookies); absent or `gold` = canon rgb(221 179 110 / 50%) (index, contact, experiences); a literal rgb()/rgba() is also accepted
pageMetadata.translations: the page's Polylang translations from its captured hreflang alternates, `en=/the-garden, da=/da/the-garden, ca=/ca/el-jardi, es=/es/el-jardin` (root-relative, extensionless). Footer switcher links each language to its translation (locale home when absent); the top bar lists the OTHER languages that have a translation (all three when the key is absent), linking their locale homes
pageMetadata.nav / footer: optional override; default is the locale's document: /nav, /footer, /es/nav, /es/footer, /ca/…, /da/…
pageMetadata.current menu item: computed by the header from the page path (li.act + aria-current), no metadata

heroSlider.duration: per-slider autoplay interval: section metadata `duration` (→ data-duration on the section; 2500 default; the-garden 3000, experiences 3500, events 2500)
heroSlider.shell: the hero section carries .hero-slider-container → full-bleed escape in styles.css; the masthead (absolute, z-index 102) overlays it
